name: amfx-nasdaq-opex-fade-pnl
description: amFX reproduction (12JUN23 p3 bottom): Cumulative P&L of fading 10-day NASDAQ momentum on Monday before quarterly OPEX. Strategy: on OPEX Monday, take opposite direction of prior 10-day move, hold 10 trading days. Step-function cumulative return from ~-20% to +43%. Source: Brent Donnelly, Spectra Markets.
source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: P&L OF FADING 10-DAY NASDAQ MOMENTUM BEFORE OPEX
# =============================================================================
# Reproduces page 3 bottom chart from amFX 12JUN23 newsletter.
# Strategy rules:
# 1. On Monday of quarterly OPEX week, measure 10-day NASDAQ return
# 2. If 10-day return is positive -> go short (fade the rally)
# 3. If 10-day return is negative -> go long (fade the selloff)
# 4. Hold position for 10 trading days after entry
# 5. Track cumulative P&L as step function
#
# The strategy produced ~43% cumulative return by June 2023.
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# Extract date components
ts = index()
month_num = datetime_extract(component='month')(ts)
day_num = datetime_extract(component='day')(ts)
dow = datetime_extract(component='day_of_week')(ts)

# Identify OPEX Monday (3rd week Monday of quarterly month)
is_q_month = (month_num == 3) or (month_num == 6) or (month_num == 9) or (month_num == 12)
is_monday = dow == 0
is_third_week_monday = is_monday and (day_num >= 11) and (day_num <= 17)
is_opex_monday = is_q_month and is_third_week_monday

# 10-day lookback return (momentum to fade)
close_10d_ago = close >> 10
ret_10d = (close - close_10d_ago) / close_10d_ago

# 10-day forward return (trade P&L) using lead operator
close_fwd = close << 10
fwd_ret_10d = (close_fwd - close) / close

# Signal: fade the 10-day momentum
# If prior 10d was up -> go short -> trade return = -fwd_ret
# If prior 10d was down -> go long -> trade return = +fwd_ret
is_momentum_up = ret_10d > 0
trade_return = (0 - fwd_ret_10d) if is_momentum_up else fwd_ret_10d

# Cumulative sum of trade returns (step function)
# Zero on non-OPEX days, actual return on OPEX Monday
trade_ret_clean = trade_return if is_opex_monday else 0.0
cum_pnl = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(trade_ret_clean) * 100.0

xy_lines(
    title='P&L of Fading 10-Day Momentum Before Quarterly OPEX',
    category='OPEX Fade Strategy',
    y_axis_label='Cumulative Return (%)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    step=StepType.StepLeft,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cumulative P&L', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Breakeven', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=0
)(ts, cum_pnl)
